palette_rationale: Preserve approved gold body gear, charcoal face, white side gears, and source eye colors in one Idle-anchored palette.
reference: Own DSTS chr009 model and native clips; PMDO registry provides action names, indices, and event fields.
ground_policy_note: Intentionally hovering, fixed shadow row 50 and source-consistent +2 px body shift; no artificial ground snap.

actions.name: Walk
actions.pose_evidence: Native hovering gear travel/bob; no feet or walking cycle invented.

actions.name: Attack
actions.pose_evidence: Native side-gear strike and body turn, with source recovery.

actions.name: Shoot
actions.pose_evidence: Native side-gear lift/release gesture; no separate projectile or effect asset.

actions.name: Sleep
actions.pose_evidence: Source resting/tilted gear pose; preserve source eyes and hover gap, no invented eyelids.

actions.name: Hurt
actions.pose_evidence: Native face/body recoil with side-gear response.

actions.name: Swing
actions.pose_evidence: Native side-gear and source face-split sweep, not a painted weapon.

actions.name: Double
actions.pose_evidence: Two cycles of source side-gear contact; PMDO XML has one HitFrame.

actions.name: Hop
actions.pose_evidence: Native gear-body lift relative to fixed shadow, without a ground takeoff pose.

actions.name: Charge
actions.pose_evidence: Source gear-body brace/tilt, reverse-sampled recovery; no invented glow.

actions.name: Rotate
actions.pose_evidence: Native gear motion with whole-view yaw and no duplicate endpoint.
